dispositions.topic_text: Source of the file-modification fallback time and number of metadata readings during delivery
Disposition when a listed regular file becomes a non-regular object before metadata reading
Whether empty or metadata-oversized named files must be opened and read
Mechanism preventing symbolic-link replacement between checks and file opening
dispositions.what: Opening a named file component by component without following a link in any folder of its path, so a link swapped in after the checks is never followed (as State 2 round-14 T20 and State 5 round-01 T26).

dispositions.topic_text: Required test evidence that condition-1-failing paths are never opened
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-02 observes the opening calls and fails when a path that fails condition 1 of A3 rule 5 is opened.

dispositions.topic_text: Required test evidence that conflict copies are never read during new placement
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-19 observes the reads and fails when a new placement reads a conflict copy.

dispositions.topic_text: Required test evidence that source-folder contents and directories are never mutated, even transiently
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-01 observes changes to the source tree during each operation, transient files and folders included, not only the final files.
